title: A Few Explicit Properties Involving Integral Transforms and Fractional Calculus of Srivastava’s Triple Hypergeometric Function Hλ, lC, P,α
content: In this paper, we obtain an extension of Srivastava’s triple hypergeometric function HC(·) by employing the extended Beta function Bλ,lp,α(x1, x2) introduced in Oraby et al. [12]. We give some of the main properties of this extended function, which include several integral representations, derivative formulas, and a few integral transforms, namely, Euler-Beta transform, Mellin transform, Laplace transform, and Whittaker transform. Further, we establish some results based on the consequences of Riemann-Liouville fractional integral and differential operators on Hλ,lC,p,α(·) . Lastly, we discuss some recursion formulas.
